stay.notes: Of 15 Kohima properties on Cleartrip, 10 showed 'No rooms available' for 18-19 Nov 2026 (Japfu, de Oriental Grand, Vivor, Kohima Camp by TUTC, Goroomgo x3, Kohima Homestay, Niraamaya, Camp Hornbill), so n is small. Anamoa Suites (apartments, 5,377-11,222) and Camp David Kigwema camp cottage (5,204 room-only, Zakhama near Kisama) were priced but not used as hotel medians. stay.nearest_base: Viswema (road trailhead) or Zakhama/Kohima; the valley itself has a government rest house with dorms
stay.price_basis: NOT PRICED: sources disagree about 8x and no official tariff page was found. Allblogs (28 Oct 2025): 'Rs 300-500 for dorm bed per person' and 'Rs 800-1500-ish for private rooms when available'. Muddie Trails (6 Dec 2023): 'dormitory accommodation is priced at 50 Rs per person', 'private rooms are available for 300 Rs per room'. Twobirdsbreakingfree (undated): floor space in either dorm 50 rupees per night. The ETLR blog (6 Jul 2021): INR 50 dormitory, INR 300 private rooms. Left null so the auditor can choose.
stay.notes: Rest house has dorms and a few private rooms, spot booking, bedding extra (Rs 50 per item per ETLR blog 2021). Entry fee Rs 100 domestic (twobirds undated). Camping Rs 500-800 tent rental (allblogs 2025).

taxi_day.basis: Twobirdsbreakingfree guide (undated, December visit): 'Expect to pay 1,000 to 1,500 INR for this service' (charter a Sumo, Viswema gate to Trekker's Point). The ETLR blog (Jul 2021) says about INR 1500 for the 8 km motorable stretch and about INR 50 for a shared Sumo seat Kohima to Viswema. Dzukou is a trek, so no local sightseeing day.

food_per_person_day.basis: Derived from rest-house kitchen prices in the Twobirdsbreakingfree guide (undated): plain Maggie 50, vegetarian meal 200, red tea 20. Budget day = Maggie 50 + tea 20 for breakfast, then two vegetarian meals at 200 = 470. Allblogs (Oct 2025) gives 'Food at rest house: Rs 150-400'; Muddie Trails (Dec 2023) says dinner 200 rupees per serving.
food_per_person_day.notes: Standard tier does not exist at the valley (rest house kitchen only).
